name: hue-menubar
title: Hue Menubar
description: Control Philips Hue lights, rooms and scenes through the Hue Menubar app's command line tool.
author: oli-harris

preferences.name: appPath
preferences.title: Hue Menubar App
preferences.description: Where the Hue Menubar app is installed.

commands.name: lights
commands.title: Lights
commands.subtitle: Hue
commands.description: Pick a light or room, then set its colour, brightness, scene or power.

commands.name: set-scene
commands.title: Set Scene
commands.subtitle: Hue
commands.description: Apply a scene to a room, or just one light's part of it.

commands.name: set-colour
commands.title: Set Colour
commands.subtitle: Hue
commands.description: Set the colour or white temperature of a light, room or all lights.

commands.name: set-brightness
commands.title: Set Brightness
commands.subtitle: Hue
commands.description: Set the brightness of a light, room or all lights.

commands.name: turn-on
commands.title: Turn on Lights
commands.subtitle: Hue
commands.description: Turn a light, room or all lights on.

commands.name: turn-off
commands.title: Turn off Lights
commands.subtitle: Hue
commands.description: Turn a light, room or all lights off.
